<Preview>
  <goa-block gap="xs">
    <goa-button version="2" type="primary">Submit application</goa-button>
    <goa-button version="2" type="secondary">Save draft</goa-button>
    <goa-button version="2" type="tertiary">Cancel</goa-button>
  </goa-block>
</Preview>
description: Button labels should clearly describe what happens when clicked. Use specific verbs like "Submit application" or "Save draft" instead of generic labels like "OK" or "Click here".
